result.plainSummary: The shared CLI and MCP work loop now preserves permission, immutable review history, retry safety, equivalent lifecycle outcomes, and clear verified progress under the tested attacks.
result.summary: Final SLC-01 approval on the combined frozen source. The unchanged operation breakers pass 10/10, including all R-01 permission and provenance fixes, wrong-workstream rejection, current tree stamping, and a different-request collision on an existing review ID that must return idempotency_conflict while preserving the first review bytes and pointer. Receipt breakers pass 6/6, and the core immutable-writer test passes 1/1. Actual CLI/MCP executable lifecycle, equivalent denial/no-effects, retry/stale/malformed/missing-evidence, and packed installation pass 4/4. The UI acceptance-progress tests pass 3/3, separating verified from reported counts, keeping empty criteria indeterminate, and reaching 100 only when every criterion is verified; root also confirmed the home-page progress bar in a production build. R-02 remains historical for its earlier tree digest and is superseded by this current-tree review.

residualRisks: Portable reviewer labels remain agent-reported attribution; authenticated human identity still depends on a trusted host boundary.
The receipt protocol coordinates participating application callers and does not claim atomicity against arbitrary direct filesystem edits.
Activity, recovery, and customizable workflow profiles remain assigned to later W-008 slices and were not graded in SLC-01.
